questions.q: What did Joseph say when the butler and baker said there was no interpreter?
choices: Do not interpretations belong to God?
questions.explain: Daniel stood in the same understanding: God is a revealer of secrets (Daniel 2:47).

questions.q: What did the three branches and the three baskets stand for?
questions.explain: The vision of dreams is the resemblance of one thing to another (Ecclesiasticus 34:3).

questions.q: On whose birthday was the chief baker hanged?
questions.explain: Birthdays are heathen customs; on Herod's birthday John the Baptist was beheaded (Matthew 14:6-8).

questions.q: What did the chief butler do once he was restored?
choices: He told Pharaoh about Joseph that day
questions.explain: Yet did not the chief butler remember Joseph, but forgat him.
